definition.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, EXL3 2.9 bpw (196 GiB + ~203 GB Engram tables), TP=2 on TensorFold via MiaAI-Lab's two-Spark recipe

launcher.pull:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; . scripts/config.sh
hf download "$MODEL_ID" --revision "$MODEL_REVISION" --cache-dir "$HF_CACHE/hub" >/dev/null
inc=(--include model.safetensors.index.json --include config.json); for f in $ENGRAM_SHARDS; do inc+=(--include "$f"); done
hf download "$ENGRAM_ID" --revision "$ENGRAM_REVISION" --cache-dir "$HF_CACHE/hub" "${inc[@]}" >/dev/null
echo "downloaded $MODEL_ID@${MODEL_REVISION:0:8} and $ENGRAM_ID@${ENGRAM_REVISION:0:8} shards: $ENGRAM_SHARDS"'
launcher.start:
docker rm -f dsv41-1017-nfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name dsv41-1017-nfs --restart unless-stopped --privileged --network host -e NFS_CLIENTS=192.168.100.11,192.168.100.0/24 -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/export" dspark-nfs:local >/dev/null
./start.sh
